name: sticky-usage
description: Your Claude plan limits inside Claude Code: /pace, a usage tool Claude can call, a quiet band above the prompt, a budget guard before subagents start, and the feed for the Sticky AI Usage desktop widget. No network, no sign-in.

feed.title: Write the usage feed
feed.description: Write this session's usage and what it is doing (working, waiting for you, done) to the Sticky AI Usage widget's feed folder. Off: no feed and no session lights.

band.title: Usage band above the prompt
band.description: auto: shows once a limit is half used or the pace says you will hit it before the reset; always; never.

contextNote.title: Usage note for Claude near a limit
contextNote.description: Near a limit, add one short note beside your prompt so Claude plans smaller steps (at most once every ten prompts).

contextNoteThreshold.title: Usage note from (percent)
contextNoteThreshold.description: The percent of a limit window at which the usage note starts (1 to 100).

exposeTool.title: Usage tool for Claude
exposeTool.description: Let Claude look up your plan usage with the usage_status tool (about 60 tokens of context).

guard.title: Budget guard for subagents
guard.description: Near a limit, before subagents start. ask: one question (run anyway, use the guard model, or skip them); downshift: run them on the guard model and say so; off.

guardThreshold.title: Budget guard from (percent)
guardThreshold.description: The percent of the 5-hour window at which the guard starts (1 to 100). It also starts when the pace says the limit is near, or at 97% of the week.

guardLeadMinutes.title: Budget guard lead time (minutes)
guardLeadMinutes.description: The guard also starts when the pace says the 5-hour limit comes within this many minutes (0 to 600).

guardModel.title: Budget guard model
guardModel.description: The smaller model subagents run on when you choose it, or in downshift: an alias such as haiku or sonnet, or a full model id.
